member.summary: Registers this options instance for validation of its DataAnnotations.
member.remarks: Synchronous validation runs when an options instance is created. When targeting .NET 11 or later, asynchronous validation (including AsyncValidationAttribute-derived attributes) runs during startup when ValidateOnStart() is also called. If ValidateOnStart() is not called, attributes deriving from AsyncValidationAttribute are never evaluated asynchronously: runtime options access triggers only synchronous validation, which invokes the attribute's synchronous fallback instead. The built-in implementation always uses synchronous attribute validation and never calls the asynchronous IsValidAsync method. Options created before startup validation or recreated by the built-in implementation after a change also use synchronous validation. If a required rule applies but cannot be evaluated synchronously, the attribute's synchronous IsValid implementation should throw to report that the invocation is unsupported instead of returning success.
